steamveil.name: Steamveil
steamveil.text: Choose a friendly character: it cannot be targeted by enemy Actions until your next turn.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.text: Restore 3 health to a character and summon a 1/1 Sprout.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.text: Enemy characters get Weakened 1 until your next turn.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.text: Choose one: deal 1 damage to up to 3 enemy characters, OR a friendly character may attack again.

choice.label: Deal 1 damage to up to 3 enemy characters
A friendly character may attack again

starflare.name: Starflare
starflare.text: Deal 4 damage to a character. This ignores Shielded (Armor still applies).

blackflame.name: Blackflame
blackflame.text: Deal 2 damage to a character. It can't be healed until your next turn.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.text: Give a friendly character Shielded and remove one negative status from it.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.text: All Location, Event, and aura effects are disabled for both players until your next turn.

refraction.name: Refraction
refraction.text: Prism + another Current: the next card of that Current you play this turn triggers its on-play effect twice.
